scopeUnmeasured.why: a Papyrus script can place, move or delete references at runtime; this probe reads records only, so the placement footprint omits anything a script puts there.
a quest alias resolves to a reference chosen at runtime, so the actor or object a quest actually moves is not in this footprint.
a *_SWAP.ini replaces a reference's base object at load; the record types and model paths counted here are the RECORD's, not the swapped base's.

a mod that only ships meshes or textures has no records to enumerate and so no footprint here, though it changes what the game draws; model paths are read off records and never resolved against the VFS.
LOD, occlusion and patcher output generated from an earlier placement is not read, so whether any of it is now stale is outside this measurement.
